extracted.intended_audience: universities, research organizations, and small businesses seeking NIEHS/NIH federal funding (extramural researchers and administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Navigating NIEHS grants and contracts — learning what types of funding are offered, where to find opportunities and notices, procurement thresholds for contracts, relevant policies, and how to connect with program staff. This page is a high-level entry point to NIEHS extramural funding resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of NIEHS grants
rubrics_metrics.description: NIEHS provides federal funding in the form of grants to universities, other research organizations, and small businesses. These grants mostly support research studies, but also cooperative research and development projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use grants to support research studies and cooperative R&D projects; applicants should align proposals with NIEHS's research mission and portfolio.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the Division of Extramural Research and Training (DERT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about the NIEHS Division of Extramural Research and Training (DERT) and its portfolio. Find and connect with DERT program staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review DERT's portfolio to ensure fit and contact program staff for clarification and guidance on program priorities and suitability of proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract Acquisitions and small procurements
rubrics_metrics.description: The NIEHS Office of Acquisitions purchases services, supplies, and other items associated with the administration of NIEHS. Find information on current contract opportunities below $25,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For procurements and non-research contract opportunities (particularly those under $25,000), consult the Office of Acquisitions listings rather than grant program announcements; follow acquisition procedures and thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding News and Events
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore news, announcements, and events related to grant application processes and policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor NIEHS funding news and events to stay current on application deadlines, policy changes, webinars, and other opportunities that affect proposal preparation and submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Opportunities and Notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about NIEHS-specific funding opportunities and contract acquisitions. Explore the types of research programs that NIH supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search NIEHS-specific opportunity listings and notices (e.g., FOAs, RFAs, program announcements) to identify appropriate funding mechanisms and programmatic priorities for submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Process and Policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore NIEHS-specific funding instructions and resources. Learn about the NIH grants process. Find NIH policy and compliance information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIEHS- and NIH-level application instructions, policies, and compliance requirements when preparing proposals; consult policy resources for regulatory and administrative obligations.
